# BayesianDomainEvolution

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A framework for adaptively updating domain models using Bayesian inference to handle non-stationary data distributions in geometric and neuromorphic AI systems. Enables TCC/iNEST systems to maintain accuracy in dynamic environments without full retraining, crucial for in-network adaptation.
